question_stem: Which statement best matches the excerpt’s combined description of DPO’s relationship to RLHF and its advantage over a naive preference-ratio objective?

According to the excerpt, which sequence of ideas is what actually allows the method to replace reward-model fitting plus RL with direct policy optimization from pairwise preferences, despite the optimal-policy formula containing the intractable partition function?

Which statement best integrates the excerpt’s two main ideas: the motivation from the coding-assistant/misconception examples and the claim about replacing RL-based preference learning with a simpler objective?
Which option most accurately characterizes how the SFT model is used during the RL phase and why the KL penalty is retained in the objective?
Which synthesis of the excerpt best explains why the authors position their method as neither a straightforward contextual dueling bandit solution nor a standard preference-based RL pipeline?

Which choice best reconstructs the excerpt’s implied logic for reusing an existing preference dataset in DPO, given that the ideal data-collection pipeline would have sampled both candidate completions from the same reference policy later used in the loss?

According to the excerpt, which statement most accurately explains why PPO-style RLHF can still be practically unstable even when it is optimizing the same underlying objective as prior work with a DPO-equivalent reward, and how that differs from DPO’s handling of the corresponding term?
Which composite description is fully consistent with the excerpt’s task-specific baseline setups and implementation details?
Which option most faithfully combines the paper’s evaluation choices across settings with the specific evidence offered for using GPT-4 as an evaluator?

According to the excerpt, what is the most accurate interpretation of the constraint \(\sum_y \pi_{\text{ref}}(y\mid x)\exp(r(x,y)/\beta)=1\) in DPO, when considered together with the discussion of reward equivalence classes and the optimal-policy formula?

Which statement best captures how the proof sketch uses the projection \(f(r;\pi_\text{ref},\beta)\) to sidestep Plackett-Luce/Bradley-Terry under-specification without sacrificing anything needed for DPO?
Which interpretation of the summarization results is most consistent with the excerpt when considering the experimental setup, temperature sweep, and comparison baselines together?
Which reading of the out-of-distribution CNN/DailyMail experiment is most consistent with the excerpt’s setup and the conclusion the authors draw from it?
Which composite statement is fully supported by the excerpt and correctly separates what the authors tentatively observe from what they leave as open questions?
Which description best matches the authors’ validation procedure for GPT-4-based summary evaluation and the reason they ultimately reported main TL;DR results with GPT-4 (C) rather than GPT-4 (S)?

Which summary best matches the authors’ full reasoning in the single-turn Anthropic HH experiments, including why they introduced a Preferred-FT model, how they treated PPO, and what they concluded about DPO?
